comment: The polyphonic input and the output carry whatever is patched in, so no family is set for them. A reset enters the same block as a clock pulse and only takes effect inside the branch guarded by the step probability, so a reset can be thrown away by the probability roll. The random offset is drawn afresh on every accepted step and is added, not replaced. The RND range switch prints its first choice as 0.2 without a v where the other nine carry one.
